violations.description: If any portion of the flight has already been flown, the agent cannot help and transfer is needed.
violations.reason: The reservation details (step 7) show flights on 2024-05-08, which are in the past relative to the current time (2024-05-15). This means a portion of the flight has already been flown. The policy unambiguously states that in such cases the agent cannot help and must transfer to a human agent. Instead, the agent proceeded to cancel the reservation (step 11) without transferring, directly violating the rule.
